description: This header file defines the interface for the WAN Manager plugin, including function declarations for initialization, support checks, and unloading within the COSA (Cisco Open Service Architecture) library. It primarily contains macro definitions, function prototypes, and include guards, with licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: WanManagerDmlInit
methods.description: Initializes the WAN Manager DML with the maximum supported version and plugin info handle.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks whether a specified object name is supported by the COSA framework.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin resources.
